title: Prepare and plan for cloud migration from Dynamics GP

facts.text: Migration assessment tool at bcmigrationassessments.com provides insight on readiness and detects potential issues.
Data migration is determined per company; choose which companies to migrate to save time and resources.
For large migrations, run from a backup of on-premises database to improve speed and minimize downtime.
Create full backup of on-premises production database.
Complete cloud migration setup including company selection.
Run replication and address any issues that arise.
Stop on-premises usage before final backup of production database.
Run Data Upgrade on cloud environment.
